notes: IntentFill-style extraction (doc 21 §4.1) and mission-concept cards. The task, size and time enums are spike-local vocabularies (doc 21 names the fields but not their values; see README), and the concept archetype list is a simplified spike-local subset of doc 26 §9.3's archetypes. 'span_any_of' compares after lower-casing, trimming punctuation and collapsing spaces. 'banned_words' uses the suite-level banned_words list.

items.request: Fill the town of Lomovo with East infantry, make it dense.

Fill these fields from the request only. Do not guess.
